materials.name: Distilled Hill Giant Might
materials.desc: A muddy brown syrup that smells of wet turf and sweat; a single drop on the tongue makes your jaw ache with borrowed strength.

recipe.lore: Three measures of hill giant blood are reduced over a slow flame with the giant's captured essence until only the stubborn, bone-deep might of the bloodline remains.

materials.name: Distilled Stone Giant Might
materials.desc: Grey, gritty and heavy as mercury, it settles in the vial like silt and never quite stops grinding.

recipe.lore: Three measures of stone giant blood are reduced over a slow flame with the giant's captured essence until only the stubborn, bone-deep might of the bloodline remains.

materials.name: Distilled Frost Giant Might
materials.desc: Pale blue and slushy, it frosts the glass from the inside and hums with the patience of glaciers.

recipe.lore: Three measures of frost giant blood are reduced over a slow flame with the giant's captured essence until only the stubborn, bone-deep might of the bloodline remains.

materials.name: Distilled Fire Giant Might
materials.desc: A glowing orange draught that ticks like cooling iron and warms the hand through a thick glove.

recipe.lore: Three measures of fire giant blood are reduced over a slow flame with the giant's captured essence until only the stubborn, bone-deep might of the bloodline remains.

materials.name: Distilled Cloud Giant Might
materials.desc: Opalescent vapour that is somehow also a liquid; the vial tries to float out of your grip.

recipe.lore: Three measures of cloud giant blood are reduced over a slow flame with the giant's captured essence until only the stubborn, bone-deep might of the bloodline remains.

materials.name: Distilled Storm Giant Might
materials.desc: Sea-green and crackling, it smells of ozone and brine, and tiny sparks leap between the bubbles.

recipe.lore: Three measures of storm giant blood are reduced over a slow flame with the giant's captured essence until only the stubborn, bone-deep might of the bloodline remains.

materials.name: Quickening Tincture
materials.desc: A jittery, amber-bright tincture that sloshes a heartbeat ahead of the vial. Cobblers and farriers soak leather and iron in it to make them hurry.

recipe.lore: Quickthorn gives the rush, the air core gives the lightness, and the blink dog's essence teaches the mixture to be somewhere else a moment early.

materials.name: Matriarch Spider Silk
materials.desc: Silvery-black thread that clings to anything and drips faintly with a venom it can no longer use. Spun only when a drider's silk is fed through a phase spider's spinnerets.

recipe.lore: Spider-crafters say every web remembers its mother: bind the silks of three spider kinds around a drider's cursed essence and the thread takes on the authority of a queen.

items.name: Alchemy Jug
items.effect: A heavy ceramic jug that, on command, fills with one chosen liquid - fresh or salt water, beer, wine, honey, oil, vinegar, even acid - in set daily amounts.

recipe.lore: A potter fires the keystone into the jug's glaze; a doppelganger's blood will imitate any liquid it has tasted, which is why a drop of each common brew is swirled inside before the final firing.

items.name: Amulet of Health
items.effect: While worn, your Constitution becomes 19 unless it is already higher, as if your blood had been replaced with something far hardier.

recipe.lore: A sliver of a heart that refused to stop beating is sealed behind bloodstone, and a boar's heart is rendered into the setting's lacquer so the vigour has something warm to cling to.

items.name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
items.effect: While worn, divination magic cannot find you or perceive you through magical scrying sensors.

recipe.lore: Old spies swear by a lead backing - scrying eyes slide off it - and pseudodragon scales, which shrug off spells in life, are laid beneath the keystone like roof tiles.

items.name: Amulet of the Planes
items.effect: Lets you attempt to cast plane shift; a mistake can fling you and your companions onto a random plane instead of your destination.

recipe.requires: The crafter must have travelled to at least one other plane.
recipe.lore: The keystone is ringed by chips of colour-pool glass, one per plane the jeweller has personally visited; the more chips, crafters say, the fewer wrong turns.

items.name: Apparatus of the Crab
items.effect: A sealed iron barrel that unfolds into a huge mechanical crab, crewed from inside by levers; it walks the seabed, swims, grips with pincers and lights the depths with its eyes.

recipe.lore: Tinkers copy the joints of a giant crab plate for plate, then trust a heart that commanded the ocean to make the whole contraption believe it belongs underwater.

items.name: Bag of Beans
items.effect: A cloth bag of dry beans; tip them out and they scatter harmlessly, but plant one and something unpredictable sprouts - a feast, a geyser, a monster, a castle in the clouds.

recipe.lore: Ordinary beans are soaked for a month in water steeped with the keystone; they come out dreaming of what they might become, and nobody - least of all the herbalist - can say which dream wins.

items.name: Bag of Devouring
items.effect: Looks like a bag of holding, but it is the mouth of an extradimensional beast: anything living that reaches inside may be dragged in and swallowed for good.

components.label: Purple worm gullet or essence (very rare)

recipe.lore: Usually made by accident: a crafter lines a holding-bag with purple worm gullet to save on astral thread, and the gullet remembers that it was once a stomach.

items.name: Bag of Holding
items.effect: A plain sack whose inside is far larger than its outside, holding up to 500 pounds while weighing only 15; pierce it or cram it into another extradimensional space and it ruptures.

recipe.lore: The lining is woven from silk that already knows how to slip between planes; tailors stitch the seams inside-out so the extra room folds away instead of spilling out.

items.name: Bag of Tricks (Gray)
items.effect: A gray bag holding small fuzzy balls; pull one out and throw it, and it becomes a random beast that obeys you until the next dawn. Its roster of animals depends on the bag's colour.

recipe.lore: Scraps of fur are felted into little balls around a drop of shapeshifter's blood; each ball remembers the shape of the pelt it came from and longs to be it again.

items.name: Bag of Tricks (Rust)
items.effect: A rust bag holding small fuzzy balls; pull one out and throw it, and it becomes a random beast that obeys you until the next dawn. Its roster of animals depends on the bag's colour.

recipe.lore: Scraps of fur are felted into little balls around a drop of shapeshifter's blood; each ball remembers the shape of the pelt it came from and longs to be it again.

items.name: Bag of Tricks (Tan)
items.effect: A tan bag holding small fuzzy balls; pull one out and throw it, and it becomes a random beast that obeys you until the next dawn. Its roster of animals depends on the bag's colour.

recipe.lore: Scraps of fur are felted into little balls around a drop of shapeshifter's blood; each ball remembers the shape of the pelt it came from and longs to be it again.

items.name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
items.effect: Makes you hardier and better liked by dwarves, grants darkvision, resistance to poison and the dwarvish tongue; worn long enough, it may even grow you a beard.

recipe.lore: Dwarven smiths set a pulse of living stone into an adamantine buckle; stoneroot tanned into the leather teaches the wearer's stomach to be as unbothered as bedrock.

items.name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes that of a hill giant, unless yours is already greater.

recipe.requires: If a distillate is used, it must come from a hill giant the crafter or their companions defeated.
recipe.lore: The leather is soaked in distilled hill giant might until it will not bend for a human hand; a trophy from the same giant is worked into the buckle so the strength knows whose it is.

items.name: Belt of Stone Giant Strength
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes that of a stone giant, unless yours is already greater.

recipe.requires: If a distillate is used, it must come from a stone giant the crafter or their companions defeated.
recipe.lore: The leather is soaked in distilled stone giant might until it will not bend for a human hand; a trophy from the same giant is worked into the buckle so the strength knows whose it is.

items.name: Belt of Frost Giant Strength
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes that of a frost giant, unless yours is already greater.

recipe.requires: The distillate must come from a frost giant the crafter or their companions defeated.
recipe.lore: The leather is soaked in distilled frost giant might until it will not bend for a human hand; a trophy from the same giant is worked into the buckle so the strength knows whose it is.

items.name: Belt of Fire Giant Strength
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes that of a fire giant, unless yours is already greater.

recipe.requires: The distillate must come from a fire giant the crafter or their companions defeated.
recipe.lore: The leather is soaked in distilled fire giant might until it will not bend for a human hand; a trophy from the same giant is worked into the buckle so the strength knows whose it is.

items.name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes that of a cloud giant, unless yours is already greater.

recipe.requires: The distillate must come from a cloud giant the crafter or their companions defeated.
recipe.lore: The leather is soaked in distilled cloud giant might until it will not bend for a human hand; a trophy from the same giant is worked into the buckle so the strength knows whose it is.

items.name: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes that of a storm giant, unless yours is already greater.

recipe.requires: The distillate must come from a storm giant the crafter or their companions defeated.
recipe.lore: The leather is soaked in distilled storm giant might until it will not bend for a human hand; a trophy from the same giant is worked into the buckle so the strength knows whose it is.

items.name: Boots of Elvenkind
items.effect: Soft boots that make no sound at all, whatever you walk on; you have advantage on Stealth checks that rely on moving quietly.

recipe.lore: Owl down is quilted into the soles and hushmoss packed into the heels; cobblers stitch in a cat's whisker so the boots know where not to step.

items.name: Boots of Levitation
items.effect: While wearing them, you can cast levitate on yourself at will.

recipe.lore: Chips of earthmote stone are hammered into the heels - they hover of their own accord - and the keystone is sewn into the tongue so the boots rise when their wearer wills it.

items.name: Boots of Speed
items.effect: Click the heels and your walking speed doubles and attacks of opportunity against you falter; the effect lasts up to 10 minutes a day.

recipe.lore: Cobblers soak the uppers in quickening tincture and lace them with a sprinter's sinew; a blink dog's pelt lines the heel, so every click lands a moment before it should.

items.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
items.effect: Your walking speed becomes 30 feet no matter how laden you are, and you can leap three times as far as normal.

recipe.lore: Axe beak tendons form the springs in the sole, goat hoof plates the toe caps, and frog skin the inner lining - every creature in the boot is a born jumper.

items.name: Boots of the Winterlands
items.effect: Fur-lined boots that grant resistance to cold, let you cross ice and snow without slowing, and keep you comfortable in bitter cold.

recipe.lore: Polar bear hide wraps the outside and its rendered fat waterproofs the seams; frost lichen is ground into the tanning brine, because a plant that thrives on glaciers knows how to keep a foot alive there.

items.name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
items.effect: Fill it with water and speak the word, and a water elemental rises from it to serve you for up to an hour. Usable once per day.

components.label: Greater water source (rare+): pure-water pearl, dragon turtle essence, aboleth mucus or young bronze dragon essence

recipe.lore: A lesser water elemental's core is sealed into the bowl as a lure; the rarer keystone is the leash - elementals answer to anything that holds a purer piece of their home plane than they do. Aboleth mucus, which lets air-breathers live under water, or a sea-loving bronze dragon's essence carry the deep ocean's authority.

items.name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
items.effect: Light a fire in it and speak the word, and a fire elemental steps out of the flames to serve you for up to an hour. Usable once per day.

components.label: Greater fire source (rare+): eternal coal, efreeti core, living flame, fire giant essence or a young red dragon's breath gland

recipe.lore: A lesser fire elemental's core is sealed into the brazier as a lure; the rarer keystone is the leash - elementals answer to anything that holds a purer piece of their home plane than they do. Fire elementals also answer to the essence of a fire giant, whose clans have bound them to their forges for ages, or to a red dragon's breath gland.

items.name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
items.effect: Swing it while incense burns and speak the word, and an air elemental coalesces from the smoke to serve you for up to an hour. Usable once per day.

components.label: Greater air source (rare+): stormglass, djinni core, roc essence, cloud giant essence or young blue dragon essence

recipe.lore: A lesser air elemental's core is sealed into the censer as a lure; the rarer keystone is the leash - elementals answer to anything that holds a purer piece of their home plane than they do. A cloud giant's essence, born of the high winds, or a young blue dragon's storm-charged essence can stand in for a genie's core.

items.name: Bracers of Archery
items.effect: While worn, you are proficient with longbows and shortbows and deal extra damage with arrows fired from them.

recipe.lore: Fletchers stitch a bowstring along the inner seam so the wrist learns its tension, and a hawk's talon is set over the pulse point - the bird never misses what it dives on.

items.name: Bracers of Defense
items.effect: While you wear no armor and carry no shield, these bracers improve your Armor Class by 2.

recipe.lore: Ironbark splints are sandwiched with scorpion carapace, then inlaid with jade; the keystone, taken from a thing that existed only to protect, spreads its vigilance across the unarmoured body.

items.name: Brooch of Shielding
items.effect: Grants resistance to force damage and complete immunity to the magic missile spell.

recipe.lore: Star-fallen iron has already survived the greatest force there is; jewellers say a brooch of it simply refuses to be struck twice.

items.name: Broom of Flying
items.effect: Speak its command word and the broom floats; you can ride it through the air, and it will fly alone to a spot you name within a mile.

recipe.lore: Hedge-witches bind feather-fern into the bristles and hippogriff quills into the collar; the elder-wood handle is cut on a windy night so it already knows the way up.

items.name: Candle of Invocation
items.effect: A slender taper tied to one alignment; while it burns, worshippers of that outlook fight and cast better, clerics recover spell power, and burning it out entirely can open a gate to its god's realm.

components.label: Divine or infernal messenger essence (very rare)

recipe.requires: Crafted on consecrated ground of the candle's alignment.
recipe.lore: The wick is steeped in the essence of an outsider who served the chosen alignment; its light is literally a prayer that has not finished being answered.

items.name: Cap of Water Breathing
items.effect: Speak the word underwater and a bubble of breathable air forms around your head until you speak it again.

recipe.lore: A sea creature's swim bladder is sewn into the crown and inflated with the keystone's breath; knitters say the cap is simply a lung that learned to stay on the outside.

items.name: Cape of the Mountebank
items.effect: Smells faintly of brimstone; once a day you can cast dimension door, vanishing and reappearing in puffs of smoke.

recipe.lore: Stage magicians insisted on the sulphur for effect; the dimension door works without it, but no one has ever dared to leave the smoke out.

items.name: Carpet of Flying
items.effect: A rug that flies on command; the bigger the carpet, the more it carries and the slower it goes.

recipe.lore: Weavers knot djinni hair into the warp and a celestial feather into the centre medallion; they say the pattern must be a map of wind, or the carpet sulks and stays on the floor.

items.name: Chime of Opening
items.effect: A hollow metal tube; strike it toward a door, lock, lid or shackle up to 120 feet away and one lock or bar opens with its ringing tone. It cracks after ten uses.

components.label: Resonant keystone (rare+): djinni core, stormglass, androsphinx larynx or a cloaker's moan sac

recipe.lore: A set of a thief's picks is melted into the silver so the tube remembers every tumbler it ever lifted; the keystone gives it a voice loud enough for locks to hear. A cloaker's moan sac resonates at pitches that loosen more than nerves; tuned into the chime, it shakes bolts free.

items.name: Circlet of Blasting
items.effect: Once per day, you can loose scorching rays of fire from the circlet.

recipe.lore: The fire gland is dried to a brittle red crystal and set over the brow; garnets flank it to hold the heat until the wearer glares.

items.name: Cloak of Arachnida
items.effect: Grants poison resistance, a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, the ability to cling upside down, immunity to webs, and once a day lets you conjure a vast sticky web.

recipe.lore: Spider venom is worked into the dye so the wearer's blood grows used to it; the eyes are sewn along the hem, because a spider never climbs anywhere it cannot see.

items.name: Cloak of Displacement
items.effect: Projects an illusion that you stand slightly away from where you are, so attacks against you have disadvantage until you are hit; it resets each turn.

recipe.lore: Blink dog pelts are cut in strips and woven crosswise so the cloak is never quite sure where it is; octopus skin adds the knack of looking like somewhere else.

items.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
items.effect: With the hood up, observers have a hard time spotting you, and you have advantage on Stealth checks to hide as the cloak shifts to match your surroundings.

recipe.lore: Skin a dire wolf — the smoke-grey pelt of a hunter that moves without sound — and weave three lengths of whisperleaf vine through it, gathered at dusk where the Feywild seeps into old forests. The vine carries the magic: it borrows the colours of whatever is around it. A breath of minor fey essence reminds the cloak it would rather not be seen.

items.name: Cloak of Protection
items.effect: A simple cloak that grants a +1 bonus to your Armor Class and saving throws.

recipe.lore: A rowan-wood toggle, silver-thread embroidery and a keystone from a guardian creature: three old wards stacked into one garment, so harm must get past all of them.

items.name: Cloak of the Bat
items.effect: Improves your stealth; in darkness you can fly by gripping its edges, and once a day you can turn into a bat.

recipe.lore: Giant bat membranes are stretched between leather ribs like a second wing; a vampire's essence, or a cloaker's hide, teaches the cloak that true flight only happens after sunset.

items.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
items.effect: With the hood up you can breathe underwater and swim as fast as you walk.

recipe.lore: Shark skin is tanned rough-side out so water flows over it without drag; the keystone is rubbed into the hood, where it keeps the gills-that-aren't wet.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.effect: A fist-sized crystal sphere that lets you cast scrying through it.

recipe.lore: The keystone is ground and folded into molten crystal; a sphinx's eye is suspended inside while it cools, so the ball has something to look out through.

items.name: Crystal Ball of Mind Reading
items.effect: Works as a crystal ball, and you can also read the surface thoughts of creatures you watch through it.

recipe.lore: Made by re-melting a finished crystal ball. An ordinary one only looks; to make it hear, speak or see truly, the glassblower must melt in something that once did those things on a scale no mortal can match.

items.name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
items.effect: Works as a crystal ball, and you can speak mind to mind with creatures you watch - even plant a suggestion in them.

recipe.lore: Made by re-melting a finished crystal ball. An ordinary one only looks; to make it hear, speak or see truly, the glassblower must melt in something that once did those things on a scale no mortal can match.

items.name: Crystal Ball of True Seeing
items.effect: Works as a crystal ball, and you see through illusions, darkness and disguises everywhere you scry.

recipe.lore: Made by re-melting a finished crystal ball. An ordinary one only looks; to make it hear, speak or see truly, the glassblower must melt in something that once did those things on a scale no mortal can match.

items.name: Cube of Force
items.effect: An inch-wide cube with faces that each raise a different invisible barrier of force around you, powered by charges that recover each dawn.

recipe.lore: Six jade pips, one per face, each ground to a different thickness; the keystone at the centre pushes outward and the jade decides what may come back in.

items.name: Cubic Gate
items.effect: A cube whose six sides are each keyed to a different plane; press a side to open a gate there or shift yourself and a companion through.

recipe.requires: The crafter must have personally stood on each of the six planes keyed into the cube.
recipe.lore: The dead-god stone is carved into a cube that remembers every plane its god walked; one pane of colour-pool glass on each face gives the memory a door.

items.name: Decanter of Endless Water
items.effect: A stoppered flask that pours fresh or salt water on command, from a trickle to a geyser strong enough to knock a person flat.

recipe.lore: The keystone is dropped into the flask before the neck is sealed shut; it will spend eternity trying to return home, and water leaks out every time it tries.

items.name: Deck of Illusions
items.effect: A box of cards; draw one and throw it, and it becomes a convincing illusion of a creature or thing that lasts until touched or dispelled.

recipe.lore: Each face is painted in pigment laced with the keystone and mistcap spores; the illusion is simply the painting stepping off the card for a while.

items.name: Deck of Many Things
items.effect: A deck of ivory or vellum cards; declare how many you will draw and each one unleashes an immediate twist of fate - wealth, power, ruin, imprisonment, a wish, or oblivion - and then the deck may vanish.

recipe.requires: Each card must be painted on a different night, beginning and ending on a new moon; if the crafter draws from the deck before it is finished, the work is ruined.
recipe.lore: No crafter alive claims to have made one: the pattern is said to be copied from a deck painted by a god who lost a bet. Folk wisdom says the wishglass gives the cards their gifts, the fey clover their luck, and the wishbloom decides - on its own whim - which is which.

items.name: Dimensional Shackles
items.effect: Manacles that fit Small to Large creatures and stop the prisoner from teleporting or travelling between planes while locked on.

recipe.lore: Devils bind souls for a living; a link of their chain in the manacle, anchored with lodestone, pulls a prisoner back to the here-and-now whenever they try to step elsewhere. The phase silk is wound tight, so the shackles know the path they are blocking.

items.name: Driftglobe
items.effect: A small glass sphere that sheds magical light or daylight and can float after you at head height.

recipe.lore: A will-o'-wisp core is the classic trick: it already wants to float at head height and lead you somewhere. Earthmote dust keeps it aloft; the keystone keeps it honest.

items.name: Efficient Quiver
items.effect: A quiver with three compartments that hold far more arrows, javelins and staves than it should, and always offers the one you reach for.

recipe.lore: A centaur's own quiver is taken apart and re-stitched as the inner lining - their quivers never run dry, they claim - and phase spider legs make the stays.

items.name: Efreeti Bottle
items.effect: A sealed brass bottle; open it and an efreeti bursts out in smoke, and depending on its mood it may serve you, grant wishes or attack.

recipe.lore: The bottle is cast from brass sweated with efreeti cinders, which remember the brass cities of the Plane of Fire; the undying ember is the bait, the brimstone seal is the lock.

items.name: Elemental Gem (Air)
items.effect: A gem holding a trapped mote of elemental air; shatter it and an air elemental appears and serves as if summoned. The gem is spent.

recipe.lore: The air elemental's core is coaxed into the turquoise on a still day; it curls up inside like a sleeper in a shell, and the skygrit packed around it hums faintly whenever a wind rises.

items.name: Elemental Gem (Earth)
items.effect: A gem holding a trapped mote of elemental earth; shatter it and an earth elemental appears and serves as if summoned. The gem is spent.

recipe.lore: Earth elemental cores settle into a cluster of deep gems as if into their own bedrock; tremor-gravel is pressed into the setting, and the gem grows heavier the longer it waits to be broken.

items.name: Elemental Gem (Fire)
items.effect: A gem holding a trapped mote of elemental fire; shatter it and a fire elemental appears and serves as if summoned. The gem is spent.

recipe.lore: A fire elemental's core sinks into the garnet like a coal into embers; flame-walker ash seals the facets, and the stone is always warm to the touch until the day it shatters.

items.name: Elemental Gem (Water)
items.effect: A gem holding a trapped mote of elemental water; shatter it and a water elemental appears and serves as if summoned. The gem is spent.

recipe.lore: The water elemental's core is poured into the aquamarine while both are wet with undertow brine; the gem looks like a drop of sea and, held to the ear, sounds like one.

items.name: Eversmoking Bottle
items.effect: Uncork it and thick smoke pours out, spreading every minute until a large area is heavily obscured; cork it again and the smoke slowly clears.

recipe.lore: The keystone smoulders forever in a nest of soot and resin; a darkmantle's gland keeps the smoke thick and dark, and the stopper is all that keeps the room breathable.

items.name: Eyes of Charming
items.effect: Crystal lenses worn over the eyes; they hold three charges of charm person, recharging each dawn.

recipe.lore: The lenses are ground from rose quartz and polished with dryad sap; the keystone is dissolved into the polishing paste so every glance carries a little of its allure.

items.name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
items.effect: Crystal lenses that let you see tiny details up close, giving advantage on Investigation checks within a foot.

recipe.lore: A giant spider's many eyes are rendered into the grinding compound; lens-makers joke that the result can count the legs on a flea before the flea knows it's being watched.

items.name: Eyes of the Eagle
items.effect: Crystal lenses that give advantage on sight-based Perception and let you pick out fine details at a distance.

recipe.lore: Giant eagle eyes are dried, powdered and fused into the glass; the keystone eye is there so the lenses see what the eagle's eyes never had the wit to notice.

items.name: Feather Token (Anchor)
items.effect: Touch it to a boat or ship and the vessel is held fast in place, as if anchored, for a day or until you touch it again. The token is used up.

recipe.lore: A feather that weighs as much as a ship's anchor sounds like a joke until you try to lift it; the living stone makes it heavy in the world's opinion, not the scale's.

items.name: Feather Token (Bird)
items.effect: Toss it and it becomes a roc-sized bird that carries riders through the air for a day, then turns back into a feather. The token is used up.

components.label: Great-bird feather (rare+): roc feather or essence, or a deva's feather

recipe.lore: A roc's pinion is trimmed down to a quill and sheathed in lesser feathers; the magic is less making a bird than letting a roc remember it once was one. A deva's feather, shed in flight, can call up a bird of equal size and far better temper.

items.name: Feather Token (Fan)
items.effect: Aboard a ship, toss it and it becomes a huge fan that fills the sails with wind for a few hours. The token is used up.

recipe.lore: Wind-seed pods are split and packed into the quill; the storm keystone gives them somewhere to blow from.

items.name: Feather Token (Swan Boat)
items.effect: Touch it to water and it becomes a great swan-shaped boat that carries passengers across lakes and seas for a day. The token is used up.

recipe.lore: Driftwood ash and current-kelp teach the feather the shape of a hull and the pull of a current; a bronze dragon's goodwill toward sailors does the rest.

items.name: Feather Token (Tree)
items.effect: Toss it onto open ground and it sprouts instantly into a sixty-foot oak. The token is used up.

recipe.lore: The feather's shaft is split and a sliver of ancient heartwood is slid inside like a seed into soil; planted, the oak simply stops waiting.

items.name: Feather Token (Whip)
items.effect: Throw it and it becomes a floating whip of force that lashes at your foes on command for an hour. The token is used up.

recipe.lore: A force-bearing keystone is ground into the barbs and bound with a bowstring; when released, the feather's spine unrolls into a lash that remembers every snap.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Bronze Griffon)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a griffon that obeys you and can serve as a mount for up to six hours, then must rest for five days.

recipe.lore: The wings are cast around real griffon feathers that burn away in the pour, leaving their shape in bronze; the talons are set in whole.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Ebony Fly)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a horse-sized giant fly that can be ridden through the air for up to twelve hours, then rests for two days.

recipe.lore: Carved from gloomwood and fitted with real insect wings; a devil's flight-gift is sealed inside because only a devil would want to ride something so foul.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Golden Lions)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a pair of real lions that fight for you for up to an hour, then must rest for a week.

recipe.lore: Each lion is cast around a dried lion heart and trimmed with real mane; the sphinx keystone, divided between them, lends both lions a sense of duty.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Ivory Goats)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes one of three magical goats - of travelling, travail or terror, depending on which figurine you throw - that carries you, fights for you or panics your foes.

recipe.lore: Three goats from one ivory: the keystone is split in thirds, and the carver swears the goats argue about who got the largest piece.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Marble Elephant)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes an elephant that obeys you for up to a day, then must rest for a week.

recipe.lore: Masons carve the elephant around an elephant's heart sealed in wax; a stone giant's essence convinces the marble it has always been alive, only very patient.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Obsidian Steed)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a nightmare that can carry you through the planes for up to a day; if your heart is good, it may try to throw you.

recipe.lore: The obsidian is knapped into the shape of a horse and fitted with nightmare hooves; the planar keystone gives it the road, and the nightmare's essence gives it the temper.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Onyx Dog)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a mastiff that speaks, sees in the dark, and spots invisible things for up to six hours, then rests for a week.

recipe.lore: Mastiff noses are the old hunter's secret for the scent; the true-seeing keystone is set as the eyes, so the dog finds what hides behind magic.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Serpentine Owl)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a giant owl that scouts for you and speaks into your mind over great distances for up to eight hours, then rests for two days.

recipe.lore: Carved in green serpentine and fletched with giant owl feathers; a telepathic keystone lets the owl tell you what it sees, even from miles away.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Silver Raven)
items.effect: A small statuette; speak the word and throw it, and it becomes a raven for up to twelve hours and can carry a spoken message to a person you describe.

recipe.lore: The raven's tongue is set in silver so the bird can repeat what it hears; the keystone gives it the sense to find the right ear.

items.name: Folding Boat
items.effect: A wooden box that unfolds on command into a rowboat or a full sailing ship with oars and sails, then folds back down again.

recipe.lore: Carpenters rub giantcap and shrinking-violet oils into opposite faces of every plank, so each board is always arguing about its size; the keystone settles the argument on command.

items.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
items.effect: While worn, your Strength score becomes 19 unless it is already higher.

recipe.lore: Ogre blood is quenched into the plates while they are still red hot; a knot of the ogre's own club is fixed in each palm, so the wearer grips like the brute did.

items.name: Gem of Brightness
items.effect: A prism with charges: it can glow, flash a blinding beam at one creature, or burst in a blinding cone; when its charges run out it is just a gem.

recipe.lore: The keystone is fused into the crystal's heart and the facets cut to focus it; prism chips make the light bend, and mica flecks stop it from leaking between blasts.

items.name: Gem of Seeing
items.effect: Look through it and you see through illusions, into the Ethereal and past invisibility for a short time; its charges recover each dawn.

recipe.lore: A true-seeing eye is dried and set into the crystal like a pupil; diamond dust in the polish clears the gem of every lie ever told about it.

items.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
items.effect: When a ranged weapon hits you, you can use your reaction to lessen the blow, and if you cut it to nothing and have a free hand, you catch the missile.

recipe.lore: The palms are lined with a sliver of frog tongue and a smear of mimic glue - anything that touches them sticks - and the keystone makes the hand move before the eye decides to.

items.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
items.effect: You climb and swim without slowing down and gain a bonus to Athletics checks for both.

recipe.lore: Lizard toe pads are sewn onto the fingertips and webbed frog skin between the fingers; the keystone makes both work whether the wall is wet or the water is steep.

items.name: Goggles of Night
items.effect: While worn, you gain darkvision out to 60 feet, or extend the darkvision you already have.

recipe.lore: The lenses are tinted with giant owl eyes and gloomsight spores; the keystone came from something that hunted in the pitch black and never needed a lamp.

items.name: Handy Haversack
items.effect: A backpack with extradimensional pouches; whatever you want from it is always on top, and it weighs the same however full.

components.label: Plane-slipping reagent (colour-pool glass, blink dog fang or faerie-ring mushroom)

recipe.lore: Three pouches each lined with phase silk, stitched together with a single thread of astral silver: the silk makes the room, the thread makes sure you can find it. A blink dog's fang or a faerie-ring mushroom, both at home halfway elsewhere, can open the inner pockets instead of colour-pool glass.

items.name: Hat of Disguise
items.effect: While wearing it, you can cast disguise self at will; the illusion ends if the hat is removed.

recipe.lore: A strip of doppelganger skin forms the hatband; octopus skin lines the brim, and tailors warn that the hat will occasionally show you a face you did not choose.

items.name: Headband of Intellect
items.effect: While worn, your Intelligence score becomes 19 unless it is already higher.

recipe.lore: Sages prefer a dried sliver of aboleth brain, whose memories go back to the dawn of the world; the thrifty make do with mind-mote dust or rememberwort, sealed behind lapis for clarity.

items.name: Helm of Brilliance
items.effect: A helm studded with diamonds, rubies, fire opals and opals, each able to release a spell of light or flame; it wreathes you in fire and harms undead with its radiance.

recipe.lore: Each gem stores a single spell, and the keystone is the flame that keeps them all lit; jewellers say the helm is less a crown than a lantern with ambitions.

items.name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
items.effect: While wearing it, you can cast comprehend languages at will.

recipe.lore: Scribes engrave every alphabet they know inside the crown; a raven's tongue, which mimics any voice, is set above the ear so the helm can mimic any meaning.

items.name: Helm of Telepathy
items.effect: You can read the surface thoughts of those nearby and speak into their minds; once a day, you can plant a suggestion as well.

recipe.lore: A homunculus shares its master's mind through a single drop of blood; bound under amethyst in the helm's brow, that drop lets you share anyone's.

items.name: Helm of Teleportation
items.effect: Holds charges of the teleport spell that recover each dawn.

recipe.lore: A scout's map is folded into the lining so the helm knows where places are; faerie-ring spores and a blink dog's essence teach it how to skip the distance between them.

items.name: Horn of Blasting
items.effect: Blow it and a deafening cone of thunder bursts out, damaging and deafening creatures and shattering glass; each blast risks cracking the horn itself.

components.label: Thunderous keystone (rare+): androsphinx larynx, thunderhead shard, djinni core, cloaker moan sac or young blue dragon essence

recipe.lore: A tyrannosaur's roar sac lines the bell and a vrock's screech organ the mouthpiece; the keystone is so loud the horn is always a little afraid of itself - hence the cracks. Lesser horns are voiced with a cloaker's moan sac or a young blue dragon's storm essence; they blast just as hard.

items.name: Horn of Valhalla (Silver)
items.effect: Once a week, sound it to summon a number of spectral berserker warriors from a hall of heroes; they fight for you for an hour, and the larger the horn's metal worth, the more of them come.

recipe.lore: The horn is cast in its metal around a berserker's trophy necklace; the keystone, taken from a being who marshals fallen warriors, is what makes the dead answer the call.

items.name: Horn of Valhalla (Brass)
items.effect: Once a week, sound it to summon a number of spectral berserker warriors from a hall of heroes; they fight for you for an hour, and the larger the horn's metal worth, the more of them come.

recipe.requires: Wielders must be proficient with simple weapons or the spirits turn on them.
recipe.lore: The horn is cast in its metal around a berserker's trophy necklace; the keystone, taken from a being who marshals fallen warriors, is what makes the dead answer the call.

items.name: Horn of Valhalla (Bronze)
items.effect: Once a week, sound it to summon a number of spectral berserker warriors from a hall of heroes; they fight for you for an hour, and the larger the horn's metal worth, the more of them come.

recipe.requires: Wielders must be proficient with medium armor or the spirits turn on them.
recipe.lore: The horn is cast in its metal around a berserker's trophy necklace; the keystone, taken from a being who marshals fallen warriors, is what makes the dead answer the call.

items.name: Horn of Valhalla (Iron)
items.effect: Once a week, sound it to summon a number of spectral berserker warriors from a hall of heroes; they fight for you for an hour, and the larger the horn's metal worth, the more of them come.

recipe.requires: Wielders must be proficient with all martial weapons or the spirits turn on them.
recipe.lore: The horn is cast in its metal around a berserker's trophy necklace; the keystone, taken from a being who marshals fallen warriors, is what makes the dead answer the call.

items.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
items.effect: Fitted to a horse or similar creature, they let it gallop a few inches above the ground - over water, sand or snow without a track - and never tire from ordinary travel.

recipe.lore: A farrier quenches each shoe in cloud giant blood or wraps it around a celestial quill; the pegasus feathers are nailed in under the hoof, where they carry the horse like a breeze.

items.name: Horseshoes of Speed
items.effect: Fitted to a horse or similar creature, they increase its walking speed by 30 feet.

recipe.lore: The shoes are quenched in quickening tincture and filed to the shape of a unicorn's hoof; the sinew wrapping keeps the horse's legs from arguing with its new pace.
